field.name: economic_nexus_threshold
field.comment: FL economic nexus gross receipts threshold - $50K (lower than typical $100K threshold)

field.name: transaction_threshold
field.comment: FL economic nexus transaction count threshold - 200 transactions

field.name: apportionment_formula
field.comment: FL uses single-sales factor apportionment (FL Statute § 220.15)

field.name: state_tax_rate
field.comment: FL corporate income tax rate: 5.5% flat rate (FL Statute § 220.11)

field.name: state_additions
field.comment: FL additions: federal interest, state tax refunds included in federal income, etc.

field.name: state_subtractions
field.comment: FL subtractions: municipal interest from other states, state income taxes paid, etc.

field.name: state_credits
field.comment: FL tax credits: enterprise zone, R&D, community contribution, capital investment, etc.
